titleEn: Hallway Bathroom Renovation Richmond BC 2026: $15K–$16K Case Study
titleZh: 列治文走廊浴室裝修案例：2026年造價$15,000至$16,000
contentEn:
Hallway bathrooms are among the most common renovation projects in Richmond houses. They serve multiple household members, get heavy daily use, and are typically the smallest bathroom in the home — which makes them deceptively complex to remodel. This case study covers a real 2026 Richmond hallway bathroom project completed by 聚星装修 (Reno Stars) for PO# 9860-rmd.

Project Overview

The bathroom was original to the house: a tub with gold-framed sliding doors, patterned beige tile, and a dark laminate vanity. The client wanted a complete refresh with modern finishes and improved functionality. Budget: $15,000 – $16,000.

The project required certified asbestos abatement before any demo could begin. The wall tile contained asbestos — a certified abatement contractor handled removal with full air testing before work resumed. This is common in Richmond homes built before the mid-1980s and always requires a licensed contractor.

What Was Done

Demo stripped everything back to the studs. Certified abatement cleared the asbestos-containing wall tile with air testing. Installation included:

  • New tub-shower enclosure with black-framed sliding glass doors
  • Marble-look surround on all wet walls
  • New vanity with integrated modern lighting
  • New toilet (wall-mounted style to save floor space)
  • New exhaust fan
  • Matte-black hardware throughout: faucet, shower head, towel bar, toilet paper holder

Key Challenge: Space and Fixed Plumbing

The bathroom's narrow layout and fixed drain locations limited layout options. Reno Stars' solution was to keep the existing drain runs and build around them: a custom narrow-profile vanity to maximise legroom, a wall-mounted toilet to free up floor space, and a corner-shelving unit above the toilet for storage without consuming wall space.

Budget Breakdown

The final contract was $15,000 – $16,000. Key cost drivers were certified asbestos abatement (required before demo), the black-framed glass enclosure, custom narrow vanity, and wall-mounted toilet. Richmond-specific factors include municipal permit fees and BC One Call utility locates.

Timeline

Asbestos assessment, abatement, and air testing added approximately one week to the schedule. The full renovation — from abatement clearance to final walkthrough — took five weeks. A straightforward replacement without asbestos issues typically takes three to four weeks.

Before and After

The gold-framed sliding doors and dated beige tile were replaced with a clean black-framed glass enclosure and marble-look walls. The dark laminate vanity was replaced with a bright, modern unit with integrated lighting. The overall effect: a 1990s bathroom transformed into a 2020s space without increasing the footprint.

Contact 聚星装修 for a hallway bathroom quote in Richmond.

FAQ

How much does a hallway bathroom renovation cost in Richmond?
Based on real 2026 projects, a full hallway bathroom remodel in Richmond typically runs $15,000–$16,000 when asbestos abatement is required, or $12,000–$14,000 without. Budget varies with scope, fixture grade, and whether plumbing reconfiguration is needed.

How long does a hallway bathroom renovation take?
A typical Richmond hallway bathroom takes 3–4 weeks without asbestos issues. If asbestos is present, add 1–2 weeks for certified assessment, abatement, and air clearance testing.

Does a hallway bathroom need strata approval in Richmond?
Most Richmond hallway bathrooms are inside strata-titled units. Strata approval is required before permits for any work affecting plumbing, structure, or fire-rated walls. Reno Stars handles the strata package as part of the project management.

What is the best shower enclosure for a narrow bathroom?
A black-framed sliding glass door enclosure is the most common choice for narrow hallway bathrooms — it requires no swing clearance and the black frame reads as a design feature rather than a space compromise.
contentZh:
走廊浴室是列治文住宅中最常見的裝修項目之一。它們服務多個家庭成員，每天使用頻繁，且通常是家中最小的浴室——這使得它們的改造出人意料地複雜。本文記錄了聚星裝修於2026年在列治文完成的一個真實走廊浴室項目，項目編號PO# 9860-rmd。

項目概覽

浴室是房子的原始風格：帶金框推拉門的浴缸、圖案米色瓷磚和深色層壓板浴室櫃。客戶希望全面翻新，採用現代飾面並改善功能。預算：加幣$15,000至$16,000。

項目在拆除前需要認證的石棉清除。牆磚含有石棉——由認證清除承包商處理，並在工程恢復前進行全面空氣測試。這在1980年代中期之前建造的列治文住宅中很常見，且始終需要持牌承包商。

完成內容

拆除工作將一切恢復到牆骨。認證清除清除了含石棉的牆磚，並進行空氣測試。安裝包括：

  • 配有黑框推拉玻璃門的新浴缸淋浴間
  • 所有濕區牆面的大理石外觀包覆
  • 帶整合現代照明的新浴室櫃
  • 新馬桶（壁掛式以節省地面空間）
  • 新排氣扇
  • 啞光黑色五金配件：水龍頭、花灑、毛巾桿、衛生紙架

主要挑戰：空間和固定管道

浴室的狹窄佈局和固定排水位置限制了佈局選項。聚星裝修的解決方案是保持現有排水走向並在此基礎上建造：定制的窄型浴室櫃以增加腿部空間，壁掛式馬桶以釋放地面空間，以及馬桶上方的角落儲物架，在不佔用牆面空間的情況下增加儲物空間。

預算明細

最終合約金額為加幣$15,000至$16,000。主要成本驱动因素包括認證石棉清除（拆除前必需）、黑框玻璃隔間、定制窄型浴室櫃和壁掛式馬桶。列治文特定因素包括市政許可費用和BC One Call公用設施定位。

時間線

石棉評估、清除和空氣測試使日程增加了約一周。從清除認證到最終驗收的整個裝修工期為五週。不含石棉問題的簡單更換工程通常需要三至四週。

前後對比

金框推拉門和過時的米色瓷磚被時尚的黑框玻璃隔間和大理石外觀牆面取代。深色層壓板浴室櫃被明亮現代的單元取代，帶整合照明。總體效果：1990年代的浴室轉變為2020年代的空間，且佔地面積未增加。

聯繫聚星裝修獲取列治文走廊浴室報價。

常見問題

列治文走廊浴室裝修多少錢？
根據2026年真實項目，含石棉清除的列治文全面走廊浴室改造通常為加幣$15,000至$16,000，無石棉則為$12,000至$14,000。預算因範圍、配件等級和是否需要管道重新配置而異。

走廊浴室裝修需要多長時間？
不含石棉問題的列治文走廊浴室通常需要三至四週。如有石棉，需額外增加一至兩週進行認證評估、清除和空氣清除測試。

列治文的走廊浴室需要 strata 審批嗎？

大多數列治文走廊浴室位於strata產權單位內部。任何影響管道、結構造或防火牆的工程都需要在許可前獲得strata審批。聚星裝修作為項目管理的一部分處理strata文件包。

狹窄浴室最好的淋浴隔間是什麼？
黑框推拉玻璃隔間是狹窄走廊浴室最常見的選擇——它不需要旋轉空間，黑框作為設計元素而非空間妥協。
